FOUR PAWS is the global animal welfare organisation for animals under direct human influence, which reveals suffering, rescues animals in need and protects them. Find out more about our sustainable campaigns and projects on www.four-paws.org.

Would you like to contribute to something meaningful and work with us along our mission? This is your chance. We are looking for dedicated people to enrich our team. 1 Digital Engagement Coordinator (m/f/d) Your contribution will be

 * Developing and distributing on-brand, timely, relevant and engaging content to FOUR PAWS audiences across owned social media channels

 * Working closely with colleagues across the organisation to plan and develop digital content

 * Supporting community management across FOUR PAWS social media channels to build relationships with our online community

 * Representing the unit in projects and campaigns planning groups, offering data-driven insights, analysis and advice

 * Keeping abreast of digital trends, sharing observations and ideas

 * Monitoring metrics and KPIs

 * Monitoring and engaging with influencers and other external stakeholders on digital platforms if needed

Your profile ideally illustrates

 * Experience in (digital) communication or other related areas

 * Experience in creating digital content and external communications assets, with digital analytics

 * Excellent writing and editing skills

 * Excellent skills in English (written and spoken)

 * Team player with high social skills, reliability, and flexibility

 * Pro-active and self-organising person, quick at adapting to a fast-changing environment

 * High level of digital affinity and very good knowledge of Microsoft 365

 * Passion for animal welfare and FOUR PAWS' vision and mission

Our offer includes

 * The opportunity to truly contribute to global animal welfare

 * An international, dynamic work environment

 * Flexible working times with the option of partial remote work

 * A dog-friendly workplace

 * Workplace health and wellbeing initiatives

 * Wiener Linien annual ticket (or partial contribution to Klima Ticket) and pension fund after probationary period

 * PAWSdays: extra days off at the end of the year on top of your 25 days of annual leave

 * Birthday leave: extra day off to use around your birthday

 * The minimum gross annual salary for this position starts at 42,000 EUR (full-time base, consisting of 14 payments), in accordance with our internal compensation scheme

At FOUR PAWS we stand up for animal welfare worldwide by empowering everyone to contribute their unique and authentic experiences and to show compassion for animals, people, and the planet. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating a workplace built on equity, inclusion, and belonging. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and abilities who share our passion for creating a better world for animals. 

Please note that in compliance with applicable laws and regulations, having a valid work permit for the respective country or being eligible to obtain one is a requirement for this position prior to commencing employment. 

Please contact careers@four-paws.org if you require assistance applying to this position. 

Application deadline: 14th of September, 2026

PATCHBOX mit Sitz in 1200 Wien ist der führende Anbieter von hochinnovativen Hardware Produkten zur Verbesserung von Arbeitsablä... 1 Partner Development Manager - France,Benelux & DACH (m/f/d)-Work Type: Full Time Prêt à laisser votre empreinte sur un marché? Ready to leave your mark on a market? 

The France and Benelux market is still wide open - we're looking for someone who wants a say in how it's built, not just someone to execute someone else's playbook. If you want real ownership and a direct line to the people making decisions, keep reading.

You'll own the France & Benelux partner ecosystem from day one, while also managing leads and accounts for selected opportunities in DACH - with room to expand into additional markets as the business grows.

What you'll do

 * Grow and develop the partner network - distributors, resellers, system integrators - across France and Benelux: recruit new partners, and take the existing ones to the next level through account management and joint go-to-market planning.

 * Create your own pipeline - develop relationships with partners and end customers directly, routing opportunities through the right partners.

 * Enable partners to sell - product training, presentations, demos and POCs, and help them position the full PATCHBOX portfolio around standardization, efficiency, and easier infrastructure control.

 * Drive market development - work with Sales & Marketing on regional campaigns, exhibitions, and events, and help build installer communities and reference stories.

 * Manage leads and accounts for selected opportunities in DACH - working alongside our existing DACH team, with growing ownership as you gain experience.

What's in it for you

 * Real ownership of a market that's still mostly untapped - a few partners exist, but the network is yours to build and develop.

 * Direct access and visibility, including regular contact with our CEO.

 * A path to more markets, more influence, and more responsibility as you grow - where you take this in two years is largely up to you.

 * Benefits like extra days off, Wiener Linien Ticket and regular team events.

 * Annual salary: EUR 60,000-83,000 gross OTE.

What you bring

 * Several years of experience in sales, channel development, business development, or account management.

 * A proactive, hunter mindset - you create opportunities, you don't wait for them.

 * Strong communication skills; comfortable picking up the phone and engaging stakeholders at every level, from technical teams to senior leadership and C-suite, and building relationships with distributors, integrators, and end customers.

 * Self-organized and independent - you set your own priorities and drive your own schedule.

 * German: minimum C1 · French: minimum C1 · English: professional working proficiency.

Nice to have: experience in IT, networking, infrastructure, or data centers; familiarity with distributors/VARs/system integrators; CRM experience (HubSpot a plus).

https://recruiting.patchbox.com/jobs/7GJJR0h_wWC8/partner-development-manager-france-benelux-dach-m-f-d

Why join PATCHBOX

PATCHBOX is changing how network infrastructure is built, maintained, and documented. Our hardware, installation tools, and software help organizations standardize their infrastructure, work faster, and cut long-term operating costs. We're a small, fast-moving team - no bureaucracy, no waiting for the tenth approval. Our founders are still hands-on in the business, and every voice carries weight from day one. What you build here will shape how PATCHBOX grows across the world. If that sounds more exciting than intimidating, we'd love to hear from you.

Curious about life at PATCHBOX, our benefits, and our hiring process? Visit our https://patchbox.com/career/. jobs.description:
1 Master Thesis "Differentiable Ray Tracing for Radio Propagation Modeling"  * Differentiable ray-tracing frameworks such as Sionna RT have become powerful tools for wireless channel modeling. This master's thesis advances differentiable ray tracing for realistic large-scale radio propagation, either by integrating atmospheric refraction models or by learning electromagnetic environment properties directly from channel measurements.
 * Under the guidance of our team, you will implement and evaluate atmospheric refraction models in the differentiable ray-tracing framework Sionna RT.
 * You will implement and evaluate differentiable algorithms for estimating electromagnetic material properties from real-world channel measurements.
 * You will learn how to develop and validate simulation workflows for large-scale radio propagation, combining physics-based propagation models with discrete ray tracing, low-complexity ray-shooting, and gradient-based optimisation techniques.

 * You will gain hands-on experience with modern wireless communication simulation frameworks, electromagnetic wave propagation, physics-based and inverse modeling, and AI-enabled optimisation methods.
 * You will work closely with researchers in wireless communications and contribute to the development of next-generation ray-tracing methods for realistic large-scale propagation prediction.

Your qualifications:

 * You are pursuing a master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Physics, or a related field.
 * First experience in at least one of the following areas: (i) atmospheric refraction modelling for ray tracing or (ii) learning environment properties using differentiable ray tracing. Candidates should explain in their cover letter how their background matches one of these areas and demonstrate relevant expertise.
 * You have solid programming skills in Python; experience with object-oriented software development is an advantage.
 * You have a basic understanding of electromagnetics, wave propagation, wireless communications, or computer graphics.
 * Knowledge of ray tracing, geometric optics, optimisation methods, or machine learning is beneficial but not required.
 * Experience with scientific computing frameworks (e.g., NumPy, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Sionna) is a plus.
 * You enjoy developing algorithms and solving challenging scientific and engineering problems.
 * You are able to work independently while collaborating effectively in an interdisciplinary research team.
 * English language skills commensurate with the role

What to expect:

 * Duration of the master's thesis project: 6 months
 * Start date: ideally 01.10.2026 - however, there is some flexibility regarding the start date
 * EUR 1.379,60 gross per month for 20 hours/week.
 * Dedicated guidance and supervision from our experienced researchers, who will support you throughout your final thesis - from the initial concept to the final results.
 * Highlights of our employee benefits include a canteen and meal allowance, organic coffee, tea and fruit baskets, preventive healthcare benefits and company doctor, additional days off for various life events, leisure subsidies, voucher programme, sports, cultural and socialising events, as well as flexitime models (incl. home office possibilities).

 

 

At AIT, we create an inclusive and family-friendly working environment that promotes equal opportunities and actively strengthens diversity across our workforce and in leadership positions. Among other initiatives, we are committed to increasing the proportion of women in our company and therefore particularly welcome applications from female applicants.

 

Please submit your complete application documents online, consisting of your CV, a cover letter, relevant certificates (transcript of records), as well as a proof of identity.
